name: Cyma
description: The ogee: two opposed quarter-arcs meeting in an S across the cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 25% 0%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 56%, transparent 56%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 75% 100%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 56%, transparent 56%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 25% 0%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 56%, transparent 56%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 75% 100%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 56%, transparent 56%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
